survivors.title: Book-code alias gap: build-my-bible / build-tracker / sample-html return 404 for legacy codes
survivors.evidence: Round-8 shipped config.resolve_book_code for notes/preview/editions API, but three read paths still do direct books_by_code()/canon_set lookup without normalization. Repro: api_build_my_bible('catholic-study', book='joh') → {"error":"unknown book: joh"}; api_build_tracker_book('catholic-study','joh') → 404; api_sample_html(...,'joh',1,1) → unknown_book — while api_build_my_bible(..., book='jhn') succeeds. Swept 6 web/API book entry points; these 3 are the only misses (covers + get_book paths OK).
survivors.fix: At the top of api_build_my_bible (normalize `book` arg), api_build_tracker_book (normalize `book_code`), and api_sample_html (normalize `book` before books_by_code check), call `book = config.resolve_book_code(book)`. Add tests mirroring test_book_codes.test_api_notes_legacy_alias_joh for all three handlers. Extend lint_rules bookcode screen to grep web_editions.py + web_content.py direct canon/book lookups.

survivors.title: Dead re-export import breaks omega.26 dead-code gate (4 pytest failures)
survivors.evidence: `from .book_codes import BOOK_CODE_ALIASES as _BOOK_CODE_ALIASES` is imported only for re-export through sources.py but never referenced in sources_base itself. Vulture flags it at 90% confidence; `tests/test_audit_dead_code.py` fails 4/4 (test_audit_clean_state_on_real_tree, test_main_clean_returns_0, test_main_json_output, test_main_min_confidence_threshold_passes_on_real_tree). Regression from round-8 book_codes centralization.
survivors.fix: Move the re-export to sources.py directly (`from .book_codes import BOOK_CODE_ALIASES as _BOOK_CODE_ALIASES`) and delete the unused import from sources_base.py; keep `_normalize_book_code` import there. Re-run `pytest tests/test_audit_dead_code.py -q`.

survivors.title: web_sources index/summary still use load_notes() — corrupt file silently undercounts
survivors.evidence: api_sources_for_book uses load_notes_checked (round-8 fix), but api_sources_index (L73) and api_sources_summary (L165) still do `notes_io.load_notes(path) if path.is_file() else []`. load_notes returns None on SyntaxError; `None or []` → 0 notes with no error envelope — same class round-8 fixed in web_notes/api_save.
survivors.fix: Switch index + summary to load_notes_checked; on dict error payload, skip book with logged warning or surface parse_error count in summary response. Add test: corrupt gen.py tuple → summary reports parse_errors=1 not note_count=0.

survivors.title: Test gap: no legacy-alias guard for build-my-bible or build-tracker-book
survivors.evidence: test_api_notes_legacy_alias_joh and test_api_preview_legacy_alias_php exist, but TestBuildTrackerBookEndpoint only tests gen/not-a-real-book and test_build_my_bible_c2_5 has no alias case. The missing normalization in web_editions.py would have been caught by a one-liner guard.
survivors.fix: Add test_build_my_bible_legacy_alias_joh and test_build_tracker_legacy_alias_joh asserting HTTP-404-free success with book code jhn in response.

survivors.title: Closed-arc reingest one-shots still live in scripts/ root
survivors.evidence: Eight `scripts/_*.py` one-shots remain after closed arcs: _reingest_eastons.py, _reingest_greek_glosses.py, _reingest_torrey_topics.py, _strip_reviewer_scaffold.py, _dehyphenate_notes.py, _dedup_ethiopian_notes.py, _fix_chapter_verse_boundaries.py. Each has a matching lint guard + pytest (e.g. test_easton_reingest.py) proving the arc shipped; no active driver imports them. RULES §7.4 says archive to dev/archive/ship_scripts/.
survivors.fix: Move the 8 files to dev/archive/ship_scripts/ with a one-line README index; keep pytest guards that scan source semantics unchanged (guards read content, not path).

survivors.title: Apple tablet (M2) profile CONFIRM-OPTIMAL — no Kobo/Kindle fork bleed
survivors.evidence: resolve_reader_eink_study_layout returns 'popup' for non-eink; inject_eink_study_backmatter gated on backmatter+eink only; apply_eink_reader_css no-op on tablet (test_marker_badge_style.test_tablet_css_unchanged). FORMAT_MATRIX apple row = target_reader tablet, packaging epub, no kepubify/kindle_post. Matches 2026-06-15-apple-m2-layout-directive.md (inline badge + vn-link geometry).
survivors.fix: confirmed optimal: ship M2 column as plain .epub + target_reader=tablet; device-proof popup typography polish only inside native aside sheet.

survivors.title: Kindle M4b presentation fork not yet implemented (phone QA blocker)
survivors.evidence: kindle_post.make_kindle_safe ships the proven june10 recipe (strip hidden, keep vn-sep, single dc:language, toc pill flatten) but does NOT suppress inline markers or relocate study notes. Phone QA (kindle_img, 2026-06-15) proves KFX noteref taps collapse to chapter page-break anchors; STK 6/6 gated delivery only. No apply_kindle_m4b_* functions in codebase.
survivors.fix: Design-first: extend kindle_post or add target_reader=kindle build branch per platform-kindle brief — suppress study badges, chapter-tail notes blocks, keep vn-link translation targets; STK phone re-test before catalog regen.

survivors.title: Build/ingest/vision orchestration CONFIRM-OPTIMAL for current program
survivors.evidence: Single-edition ~133s cold floor with mtime cache + byte-stability pins holds. enabled_kind_codes single resolver verified across matrix/build/web. At-scale drivers share at_scale_base.emit_extent_ok. Vision marathon OOM history argues against higher parallelism without RAM guards.
survivors.fix: confirmed optimal: defer unified meta-driver ingest until post-v1.0.0; any build speedup must prove 9-edition byte-identical output.
